summary: Change Agents Corporation, a Delaware-incorporated Nasdaq-listed (CHGA) shell-like technology company formerly known as Avalon GloboCare, filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026 reporting a September 8, 2026 financing. The company issued $280,000 aggregate principal amount of 7% original issue discount notes (including a $30,000 OID) for gross proceeds of $250,000 to accredited investors, plus pre-funded warrants to purchase 1,000,000 shares at $0.0001. Proceeds repay $19,710 under a Vanquish Funding Group note and $19,710 under June 2025 18.75% notes, with the remainder for working capital. Notes mature April 8, 2027, are prepayable at 105%, carry negative covenants, and include an MFN provision. Nasdaq 19.99% shareholder approval is required before warrant shares can exceed the cap. This is a routine small-cap financing, not a special situation.
